dog.description_text:
With his adorable oversized ears and puppy charm, Wally is sure to make you smile. This cute little guy is ready to take on the world one adventure at a time and is looking for a family to grow up with. He can't wait to trade shelter life for a home filled with love, fun, and plenty of cuddles.
He is available at our Westhampton Adoption Center, head in to meet them and see if you are a match! We are a same-day adoption center, and an application does not put you on a list or hold an animal for you. If they are in Wantagh or in a foster home, please submit an online application and our team will reach out to further discuss the adoption process. Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped, and given their age-appropriate vaccines.
dog.name: Wally
